name: Propose a minimal intake schema without writing
query: Suggest a Notion database for our volunteer requests. One row is a request; we need to triage new requests and see assigned work. Keep the proposal in chat; do not build anything.
success_criteria: Returns a usable, minimal schema and task-oriented view definitions in chat.
Explains why the chosen properties support triage and assignment without inventing organizational requirements.
Creates no database, proposal page, sample records, or other workspace content.
Does not require unrelated discovery or user confirmation to supply the requested design.
